title: RAG-LLM ICD-10 coding pipeline and audit protocol
description:
The pipeline and audit protocol from the paper Context and capacity interact in a retrieval-augmented LLM pipeline for ICD-10 coding: a component-wise audit. It contains the note-blind floor, the loss decomposition (oracle-over-shortlist bound and random-pruning null), note-level paired bootstrap and approximate-randomization testing, the context x capacity interaction and the three-point capacity curve, the cross-patient evidence-provenance measurement, an exact-quote grounding metric the model cannot self-report, a label-wise attention supervised control, the shared-partition split builder, the checklist prevalence scoring, a provenance guard for machine-generated tables, and a script that re-checks every number reported in the manuscript against its stored artifact.

The release contains the full pipeline (retrieval, LLM scoring, evidence constraint, contrastive verification, baselines, optimization) as well as the audit code, so that the paper's results can be checked against the implementation that produced them.

No clinical data are included. MIMIC-IV is available to credentialed researchers through PhysioNet under its data use agreement and is not redistributed here; the stored artifacts are aggregates and carry no identifiers.
